description: HAP decode + upload path regression gate. Loads a tiny HAP Alpha (BC3 RGBA) .mov fixture, seeks to a known frame, hashes the compose target. Verifies: (1) HAPDecoder correctly parses snappy-compressed HAP packets via HapFormat, (2) BC3 textures upload to D3D12 via the TextureFormat plumbing, (3) the compositor samples them and produces the expected output. Fixture generated by running HapTranscoder against test_media/gradient_seq/; committed at test_media/hap_gradient/.
